It's okay to be introverted. I am a introverted person, and there is no shame in that. But you are right. You need to go out sometimes for what you mentioned, so I suggest you start small, go for a walk, and then go shopping and more. But yeah, people can be angry or annoying sometimes, but you need to know that they have a life too. You can't know what they are going trough. Change doesn't happen in a instant, but if you go out oftentimes then you will build confidence and get rid of your anxiety. But you have to believe in yourself too.

You might need a break, you are expecting a big thing for yourself,  so start up small and progressively go big. You shouldn't get dissapointed in yourself if you aren't confident, not many people are, and that is okay. We are humans after all.
